title: The Boots of Buffalo Leather

full_text:
A fearless discharged soldier wearing heavy boots of buffalo leather wandered through a dark forest when he met a stranger whose horse had broken its leg. The two men took shelter in an isolated hut, unaware that it was the den of a notorious band of bloodthirsty robbers.

An old woman guarding the hearth warned them that the robbers would soon return and slit their throats. While the stranger trembled in terror, the soldier calmly sat by the fire, smoked his pipe, and demanded roast pork and wine.

When the robber chief and twenty cutthroats stormed into the hut with drawn blades, the soldier did not flinch. "Welcome, brothers!" shouted the soldier. "Sit down and drink with us!"

When the robbers lunged to butcher them, the soldier drew his heavy sabre and fought with breathtaking fury, kicking with his stout buffalo boots and swinging his blade until he routed the ruffians, locking the survivors inside the cellar.

The soldier and his companion returned safely to the capital. There, the stranger revealed himself as the King! In recognition of the soldier's extraordinary bravery and loyalty, the King appointed him General of the Royal Guard, granting him lands and gold, while the veteran proudly wore his boots of buffalo leather to the finest royal banquets.
moral: Fearless bravery in the face of danger turns terrifying perils into triumph and honor.

quiz.question: What is the central moral lesson taught in "The Boots of Buffalo Leather"?
options: Presence of mind and quiet wisdom triumph over brute strength.
Acting in haste and anger without thinking
Believing rumors and flattery without proof
quiz.hint: Remember the moral lesson of this traditional story.

quiz.question: How do the characters overcome their challenge?
options: Through patience, calm reflection, and wisdom
By shouting loudly and blaming others
By running away from every problem
quiz.hint: Consider the virtues praised in world folklore.

quiz.question: What memorable conclusion does this story teach young readers?
options: Honesty, kindness, and clear thinking lead to peace
quiz.hint: Reflect upon the resolution of the story.
